title.context: Title for the calendars settings section

delete.context: Accessibility message for the delete icon

calendarCreationNotif.string: Trimite notificare când un calendar este creat
calendarCreationNotif.context: Label for the calendar creation notification setting

calendarViewFirstDay.string: Prima zi a săptămânii în vizualizarea calendarului
calendarViewFirstDay.context: Label for the setting that determines the first day of the week in calendar view (0=Sunday..6=Saturday)

workdayStartTime.string: Ora de început a programului de lucru
workdayStartTime.context: Label for the setting that determines the start time of the workday (e.g. 09:00)

workdayEndTime.string: Ora de sfârșit a programului de lucru
workdayEndTime.context: Label for the setting that determines the end time of the workday (e.g. 18:00)

busyOffHours.string: Afișează ca ocupat în afara orelor de program
busyOffHours.context: Label for the setting that determines whether to show as busy during off hours

calendarDaysShowed.context: Label for the setting that determines which days are showed in calendar view (array of 0=Sunday..6=Saturday)

calendarWeekNumberFormat.%U: Sunday as the first day of the week
calendarWeekNumberFormat.%W: Monday as the first day of the week
calendarWeekNumberFormat.string: Modul în care este evaluat numărul primei săptămâni
calendarWeekNumberFormat.context: Label for the setting that determines the week number format in calendar view (%U, %W or %V)

calendarDefault.string: Calendar implicit ales la crearea unui eveniment nou
calendarDefault.context: Label for the setting that determines the default calendar

eventDefaultClass.context: Label for the setting that determines the default classification for events (PUBLIC, CONFIDENTIAL or PRIVATE)

taskDefaultClass.context: Label for the setting that determines the default classification for tasks (PUBLIC, CONFIDENTIAL or PRIVATE)

journalDefaultClass.string: Clasificare implicită pentru intrările din jurnal
journalDefaultClass.context: Label for the setting that determines the default classification for journal entries (PUBLIC, CONFIDENTIAL or PRIVATE)

eventDefaultReminder.context: Label for the setting that determines the default reminder for events (e.g. -PT15M)

taskDefaultReminder.context: Label for the setting that determines the default reminder for tasks (e.g. -PT15M)

journalDefaultReminder.string: Mementou implicit pentru intrările din jurnal
journalDefaultReminder.context: Label for the setting that determines the default reminder for journal entries (e.g. -PT15M)

noInvitation.string: Previne adăugarea ca participant de către alți utilizatori
noInvitation.context: Label for the setting prevent user to be add as attendees by others users

noInvitationWhitelist.context: Label for the setting that determines the whitelist of email addresses to which invitations will be sent even if 'Do not send invitations' is enabled

doNotSendInvitFromDav.string: Nu trimite invitații pentru evenimentele create din clienți CalDAV
doNotSendInvitFromDav.context: Label for the setting that determines whether to send invitations for events created from CalDAV clients or not

davForceSyncFromClient.string: Forțează sincronizarea evenimentelor create din clienții CalDAV
davForceSyncFromClient.help-tooltip: Warning: if events from the client are more recent, force the sync anyway
davForceSyncFromClient.context: Label for the setting that determines whether to force synchronization of events created from CalDAV clients or not
